summary: KIS SØR AS (org. no. 984 625 391) is a private limited company (AS) based in Råde, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2002-06-25. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 33.120 (Reparasjon og vedlikehold av maskiner); it has 74 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 163.0 m and net income was NOK 19.7 m. CEO: Pål-Arne Rudi Nauf; board chair: Martin Fusche; auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS.
